about: What FunctAI declares a model can do, from the provider lm15 routes it to and its name (contract/functions.md, 'Capabilities'). lmcc never guesses a model's abilities: these facts choose the layout's transports (reasoning, tools), stop sequences and structured output. A function's `capabilities` setting overrides any of them.

native.about: Providers whose API has native tool calls, stop sequences and an enforced JSON schema.

fixed_sampling.about: Models that run only at temperature 1 and top_p 1, and refuse a request with any other value (seen live, 2026-09-27). By the provider (after speaks_as) and model-name prefix.

speaks_as.about: Subscription providers that speak another provider's API: the same facts as that provider.

chat_completions.about: OpenAI's Chat Completions door: native tools and JSON schema, no stop sequences, no thinking text back.

native_tool_hosts.about: OpenAI-compatible hosts whose current models take native tool calls.

judgment_only.about: Providers that answer only judgments (typed questions with a probability for each answer, lm15 MAP-14).

no_storage.about: Providers that keep requests and replies on their side unless a request sends store: false (OpenAI's Responses API keeps them 30 days). FunctAI sends store: false there when a call's settings give no store (functions.md, 'Requests the provider would keep'). Seen live 2026-10-06: kept requests also answered slower (gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4.1, gpt-4o-mini: median 0.88-1.36 s kept, 0.69-0.91 s with store: false). By the provider a call is routed to.

probe.about: The fixed facts a version is computed under (contract/calls.md, 'Versions'), with provider "probe".
